info.title: Election.org Public Data API
info.description: Source-first public election data. Public beta coverage is explicit; null and omitted values are never silently converted to zeroes or inferred facts.

Citation.description: Suggested attribution, not a forced backlink or new license. Collection sources are not necessarily evidence for every returned record. Dates are not request generation times.

original_sources.description: Returned-data source references. References explicitly marked applies_to_returned_records: false remain in response sources but are excluded here.

record_date.description: Date on the cited record, not a source check or dataset update

updated_at.description: Explicit dataset update date, or null when unspecified

verified_at.description: Latest stated source check; does not establish freshness of every record

get.summary: Search permanent country foundations
get.description: Returns permanent records for every World Bank country with a published 2024 Population, total value of at least 50 million, plus the prior G20-plus-Spain foundation and official-source expansions. Aggregate regions and income groups are excluded. Records include stable IDs, sourced population values, International IDEA electoral-management labels, official national-authority links when asserted, IPU-mapped parliamentary institutions, and explicit missing coverage. A record is not a claim that national election data is complete.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: ISO alpha-2, ISO alpha-3, canonical slug, or known country alias.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Country name, code, region, or subregion.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Exact region label, such as Americas, Asia, Europe, or Pacific.

200.description: Source-linked country foundations and an explicit international coverage contract

get.summary: Search authoritative international election results
get.description: Search authoritative national election results including Ethiopia's official source-bounded 2021 general-election layer, Uganda's official final 2021 presidential result, and Egypt's official final 2024 presidential result. Ethiopia exposes the September House and regional-council aggregates for Harari, SNNP, and Somali without treating that three-region table as a complete national result or inventing candidate votes or current tenure. Source-specific vote, seat, candidate, personal-vote, elected-result, alternate, aggregate-only, document-coverage, and disputed-territorial-scope layers stay separate.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Current coverage includes Ethiopia ET/ETH, Uganda UG/UGA, and Egypt EG/EGY alongside the other published country adapters. Amharic ኢትዮጵያ and Arabic مصر are also accepted by the runtime endpoint.

parameters.name: round
parameters.description: Brazil 2022 presidential round (defaults to 2), or the round in which a French constituency seat was decided.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: India State/Union Territory, UK region/nation, Canadian province/territory, Australian state/territory, German Land, French department, South African province, Mexican state, Brazilian federative unit/overseas result group, Japanese prefecture, Argentina electoral district, Republic of Korea region, Indonesian province/overseas result district, Türkiye province, Nigeria state/FCT result-document coverage record, Pakistan province/area aggregate, Poland voivodeship, Sweden Riksdag constituency, or Russia CEC commission row; accepts names, native names where available, codes where available, or Election.org slugs.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: UK Parliament region or nation name, Republic of Korea regional total, Indonesian geographic result, Türkiye province, or Election.org slug.

parameters.name: province
parameters.description: Canadian province or territory, South African province, or Spanish Congress constituency name or Election.org slug.

parameters.name: prefecture
parameters.description: Japanese prefecture name, native name, two-digit code, ISO 3166-2 code, or Election.org slug.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: French department name, official code, or Election.org slug.

parameters.name: commission
parameters.description: Russia CEC commission name or Election.org slug, such as Москва. Use the separate id parameter for a permanent record ID.

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: Italian 2022 Chamber single-member district label, Argentine 2023 runoff electoral-district ID, or Netherlands 2025 electoral-district ID, name, or Election.org slug.

parameters.name: record_type
parameters.description: For Italy, return district or raw list-mark records. For Spain, return province, party, or historical elected-member records. For the Netherlands, return district, party, or historical elected-member records. For the Republic of Korea, return region or historical candidate-result records. For Indonesia, return region or historical candidate-ticket result records. For Türkiye, return province, final component, or historical candidate-result records. For Nigeria, return the national declaration, historical candidate-result records, or state/FCT result-document coverage records. For the Philippines, return national, Senate candidate, or party-list records. For New Zealand, return national, party, electorate, or historical candidate-result records. For Poland, return region or historical candidate-result records. For Sweden, return national, constituency, named party, or historical candidate personal-vote records. For Russia, return national, CEC commission-row, or historical candidate-result records.

parameters.name: party
parameters.description: Germany first-vote or second-vote party/choice label, French official candidate nuance code, South African party name or abbreviation, Japanese filing-party category, Italian published list label, Argentine runoff political grouping, Spanish seated-party family, Netherlands party name or official ID, or Republic of Korea candidate party. Italy returns raw direct list marks, not a final legally apportioned party total.

parameters.name: represented
parameters.description: For South Africa or Japan, filter to parties/categories with seats (true) or without seats (false).

200.description: Historical constituency results, candidacy records where safely available, source fingerprints, and explicit coverage limits

404.description: Requested permanent result ID was not found

422.description: Country or year is not yet supported
